note: Game functions by name (SDK 16, hellforge_functions.h): each one's place in its module (rva), its first bytes as reviewed (code, an IDA-style pattern the loader checks before every use, through other hooks), its C signature and what each argument is. hook: true only where the signature is whole (every argument the function takes, unnamed ones as pass-through slots, and its return value), so a detour passes everything on; the others are for calling. The loader resolves them only on this build: a new game build revalidates every entry.

params.name: event
params.meaning: the DamageEvent: +0 target entity, +4 kind, +8 element, +0x10 dealer and +0x14 owner network ids, +0x18 creditor peer (u64), +0x2C amount (i32), +0x50 the hit position (3 floats)

ConsumeDamageEvent.meaning: Takes one damage event from this machine's queue in the frame's drain, before ApplyDamage's armour and multipliers. HF_ON_DAMAGE and HF_ON_DAMAGE_PRE come from it; a detour that changes the amount at +0x2C changes the damage
ConsumeDamageEvent.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's HF_ON_DAMAGE hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: creditor
params.meaning: the peer id the kill is credited to

params.name: dealer
params.meaning: the entity that dealt the killing damage

KillDispatch.meaning: Tells the game something was killed, on the victim's owner. HF_ON_KILL comes from it
KillDispatch.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's HF_ON_KILL hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: type
params.meaning: the StratagemType (HF_STRATAGEM_..., or a mod's from add_stratagem)

ActivateStratagemBeacon.meaning: Activates a stratagem's beacon once it lands, once per beacon, on the thrower's machine. HF_ON_STRATAGEM comes from it
ActivateStratagemBeacon.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-actions; HellForge's HF_ON_STRATAGEM hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: entity
params.meaning: the new entity's id in this session

params.name: resource
params.meaning: the entity's resource id (HF_ENTITY_..., or a mod's)

params.name: info
params.meaning: the SpawnInfo: +0 authority byte (1: this machine is in charge of it), +4 network id (u32)

SpawnEntity.meaning: Spawns an entity into this machine's world, remote spawns included. HF_ON_SPAWN comes from it, after the original returns
SpawnEntity.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-actions; HellForge's HF_ON_SPAWN hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: queue
params.meaning: the explosion queue: hf_global_ExplosionQueue (256 requests a frame)

params.name: creditor
params.meaning: the peer id its kills are credited to

RequestExplosion.meaning: Requests an explosion in this machine's world: projectile impacts, explosives, stratagems, chained blasts. HF_ON_EXPLOSION comes from it; hf->spawn_explosion is the checked way to call it
RequestExplosion.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-explosions; HellForge's HF_ON_EXPLOSION hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: fraction
params.meaning: the share of its maximum health to add, to its health and every limb

AddHealthFraction.meaning: Heals an entity by a share of its maximum health. hf->heal is the checked way to call it

params.name: zone
params.meaning: the damage zone's name hash (a Helldiver's head 0x8C5570C9, torso 0xAA1DB0B0, arms 0x1880288E and 0xB6F2BAF5, legs 0x64A3FA1D and 0x87B05FF4)

RestoreZone.meaning: Restores one damage zone (a limb) to full. hf->heal_limb is the checked way to call it

params.name: buildup
params.meaning: how much of the status builds up

QueueStatusRequest.meaning: Queues a status buildup on an entity (4096 a frame: hf_global_CombatQueues' status_count). Host only. hf->apply_status is the checked way to call it

params.name: entity
params.meaning: the entity, which must have a motion record

SetVelocity.meaning: Sets an entity's velocity. hf->add_velocity is the checked way to push the local Helldiver

params.name: system
params.meaning: the projectile system: hf_global_ProjectileSystem (running while its running field is 1)

params.name: type
params.meaning: the ProjectileSettings row (HF_PROJECTILE_..., or a mod's)

FireProjectile.meaning: Fires a projectile. Host only, in a mission, with the projectile's package loaded. hf->spawn_projectile is the checked way to call it

params.name: kind
params.meaning: the damage kind (HfDamageEvent.kind; injure passes 6, ability, as the VG-70's own self-damage does)

params.name: network
params.meaning: a network id: injure passes the Helldiver's own

params.name: network2
params.meaning: a network id: injure passes the Helldiver's own

params.name: creditor
params.meaning: the peer id credited: injure passes the one in the Helldiver's health record (+0x38)

params.name: direction
params.meaning: the hit's direction (3 floats; injure passes 0, 0, -1)

params.name: position
params.meaning: the hit's position (3 floats; injure passes 0, 0, 0)

params.name: actor
params.meaning: the hit actor: injure passes the limb's, from the engine's UnitActorByName (helldivers2.exe 0x799DE0)

QueueDamage.meaning: Queues a damage request (4096 a frame: hf_global_CombatQueues' damage_count) that the frame's drain applies. hf->injure is the checked way to call it, on a limb of this machine's Helldiver
QueueDamage.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat, player-injury-path; HellForge's injure (actions.c)

NeedsAmmo.meaning: Whether a Helldiver needs ammunition (1) or not (0), as the Supply Pack's self-use asks. hf->resupply_from_pack calls it before TryStartAction

params.name: context
params.meaning: the entity's action context: hf_global_ActionManager + 0x53E170 + 0x1238 index (+0 the entity, +8 the running action)

params.name: request
params.meaning: 3 u32: the action (2629, the Supply Pack's self-use), the game's no-action id (u32 at game.dll+0x3483C5C), the context's +0xC

TryStartAction.meaning: Starts an action on an entity if it is free to: 1 started, 0 not. hf->resupply_from_pack is the checked way to call it

params.name: out
params.meaning: receives the new entity's id (0: none made)

params.name: resource
params.meaning: the entity's resource id (HF_ENTITY_...), registered in this mission

params.name: spawn
params.meaning: 0x58 bytes: +0 1, +4 network id (0x7FFF none), +8 the pose (4x4 floats, the position in the last row), +0x48 a pointer to a 0x8A0-byte spawn context (a transport Pelican's hover point at +0x610)

RequestEntitySpawn.meaning: The entity spawn request: makes an entity of a resource at a pose; returns out. hf->spawn_pelican is the checked way to call it (host only, in a mission, with shuttle_transport)

params.name: ctx
params.meaning: the ability's context: +8 the entity it runs on

AbilityTick.meaning: Runs one tick of an ability, switching on its id through a 2867-entry table: 1 when it is done, 0 while it runs (and for an unknown id). HellForge points its id check at a stub for abilities of its own (hf->add_ability)

SiloMissileArmedAbility.meaning: Ability 2088, the Solo Silo missile's armed ability, which its launch starts: tick 0 the launch blast (explosion 172), tick 2 it leaves the rack, tick 120 it arms and is done (1)

params.name: out
params.meaning: receives the missile (the no-entity id when the link names none)

LinkedMissile.meaning: The missile a silo's targeting remote is linked to; returns out

params.name: descriptor
params.meaning: a linker instance's descriptor (hf_global_WeaponLinkerManager's descriptors, by index)

LinkerRecord.meaning: A WeaponLinker instance's record (12 bytes; +4 0x06212002 a silo remote's link, which launches its missile): this machine's copy for an instance it has authority over, else the resource's shared one. NULL for no descriptor

params.name: out
params.meaning: receives the rack (the no-entity id when the link names none)

LinkedRack.meaning: The hellpod rack a silo's targeting remote is linked to; returns out

SetMissileEngine.meaning: Turns a seeking missile's engine on or off, as a silo remote's link does at a launch

LaunchMissile.meaning: Launches a seeking missile: sets off its explosive, which starts its armed ability (2088 for the Solo Silo's), and marks it launched (its instance's +0x36)

SetExplosiveOwner.meaning: Names an explosive's owner, as a silo remote's link does for its missile at a launch

params.name: entity
params.meaning: the guided entity (a missile in hf_global_GuidanceTargets' map)

params.name: point
params.meaning: the point it flies to (3 floats)

SetGuidanceTarget.meaning: Sets an entity's guidance target, as a silo remote's link does with its laser's point

params.name: item
params.meaning: the item it lets go of (a silo's missile)

RackReleaseItem.meaning: Has a hellpod rack let go of an item, as a silo remote's link does at a launch

params.name: mode
params.meaning: 1 on the machine with authority over the entity; 2 without it, whose start is always sent on

StartAbility.meaning: Starts an ability on an entity; the ability manager then ticks it (AbilityTick). HellForge's silo countdown starts its ability on the missile with it, and its shield wall detours it to see enemies' charges
StartAbility.source: HellForge's silo countdown (abilities.c) and shield wall hook (shield_block.c)

params.name: ctx
params.meaning: {EntityInfo*, P*}: P the behaviour record + 8 (P+0 the stage)

BehaviourUpdate.meaning: Updates an entity's behaviour, switching on its id through a 693-entry table, on the machine with authority over the entity. HellForge points its id check at a stub for behaviours of its own (hf->add_behaviour)

params.name: ctx
params.meaning: {EntityInfo*, P*}: P the behaviour record + 8 (P+0 the stage)

BehaviourStage.meaning: Moves an entity's behaviour to a stage, switching on its id through a 693-entry table. HellForge points its id check at a stub for behaviours of its own

BehaviourEvent.meaning: Hands an event to an entity's behaviour, switching on its id through a 693-entry table. HellForge points its id check at a stub for behaviours of its own

BehaviourResume.meaning: Resumes a behaviour on a machine without authority, after its record arrives from the network: for the transport Pelican (667) it sends the mover to the replicated flight target (P+0x1BC). HellForge sends its own behaviours into its base's case

params.name: ctx
params.meaning: {EntityInfo*, P*}: P the behaviour record + 8 (P+0 the stage)

PelicanTransportUpdate.meaning: Behaviour 667's update, the transport Pelican: flies to the beacon (stages 1-3), hovers (6, entered with P+0x180 = now), releases its cargo after 6 s, departs and is removed. HellForge's Pelican behaviours (hf->add_behaviour) run it

params.name: stage
params.meaning: the stage it enters (6: the hover)

PelicanTransportStage.meaning: Behaviour 667's stage change, the transport Pelican

PelicanTransportEvent.meaning: Behaviour 667's event handler, the transport Pelican

BehaviourOwnPosition.meaning: A behaviour's entity's own position: its unit's root node from the scene graph; returns out

BehaviourOrbitStep.meaning: The extraction Pelican's orbit step: writes the next point on its orbit to P+0x1BC (the replicated flight target)

params.name: target
params.meaning: the point to fly to (3 floats)

BehaviourMoveTo.meaning: Sends a flying behaviour's mover to a point

BehaviourFace.meaning: Sets the hover controller's desired facing, turning a hovering behaviour's body

params.name: ctx
params.meaning: {EntityInfo*, P*} (a mounted turret's: P+0x10 its target, P+0x70 set while it has one)

BehaviourTargetPosition.meaning: Where a behaviour's target is (a turret's aim point); returns out

PelicanTurretIdle.meaning: Behaviour 645's stage 1 update (idle), the Pelican's chin turret

TurretActive.meaning: Whether a behaviour's turret is active (behaviour 645's firing stage tests it)

TurretHasAmmo.meaning: Whether a behaviour's turret has ammunition (behaviour 645's firing stage tests it)

params.name: stage
params.meaning: the stage it enters: 1 idle, 2 aim, 3 fire, 4 inactive

PelicanTurretStage.meaning: Behaviour 645's stage change, the Pelican's chin turret

params.name: entry
params.meaning: a perceiver's entry for the target (FindPerceptionEntry; +4 its position), or NULL to clear

BehaviourSetTarget.meaning: Installs a perception entry as a behaviour's target (P+0x10), or clears it

WeaponDegreesTo.meaning: The angle in degrees between a weapon's forward and a point

params.name: info
params.meaning: the entity's info, or NULL to look it up

IsValidTarget.meaning: Whether an entity is a valid target: it exists, is alive and has no flag 25

FindPerceptionEntry.meaning: A perceiver's entry for an entity (+4 its position), or NULL when it has none

MagazineRounds.meaning: The rounds in a weapon's magazine

AddMagazineRounds.meaning: Adds rounds to a weapon's magazine, on the machine with authority over it

params.name: max_degrees
params.meaning: the most the weapon may be off (behaviour 645: 2)

WeaponWithinDegrees.meaning: Whether a behaviour's weapon points within max_degrees of a point: behaviour 645's fire gate

EntityDescriptor.meaning: An entity's descriptor in this machine's world: +0 its resource (u64), +0xC its unit's index, +0x14 bit 0 set where this machine has authority over it; NULL for none
EntityDescriptor.source: HellForge's behaviours and co-op diagnostics (behaviours.c, abilities.c, coop_diag.c)

params.name: mask
params.meaning: the fields to send (0xE00: a behaviour's flight target, P+0x1BC)

MarkReplicated.meaning: Marks fields of an entity's behaviour record replicated, so the other machines receive them; does nothing without authority

params.name: binding
params.meaning: a shield's binding (hf_global_ShieldManager's bindings, by index)

ShieldRecord.meaning: A shield's record (the stats' Shield record: +0 the radius, +0x78 the bubble unit), as the game's own readers get it; NULL for no binding

MoveObject.meaning: One object's motion for a frame, on the motion jobs, ending at the single write of its position (MotionManager's positions). HellForge's shield wall detours it to hold enemies outside a bubble

params.name: descriptor
params.meaning: the shot: +0x10 its ProjectileSettings row (pointer), +0x18 the weapon's entity

params.name: extra
params.meaning: not reviewed: the ProjectileWeapon fire path passes its own

SpawnProjectile.meaning: Spawns a shot into the projectile pool, copying its flight and armour penetration from its rows; returns its slot (its hit record at pool + 0x4D040 + 0xC8 slot). HellForge redirects the ProjectileWeapon pellet call (0x616612) to give other players' shots their own rows. The artillery's shells fly from it, with their ProjectileSettings row's speed (+0x20), drag (+0x28) and gravity
SpawnProjectile.source: HellForge's co-op round stats (rounds.c); HellForge's artillery reach (difficulty_artillery.c)

params.name: parent
params.meaning: its parent in the catalogue (children link to the root appended just before them)

CatalogueAddItem.meaning: Appends a record to the item catalogue (hf_global_ProgressionManager), as the login's catalogue reply does. On the game thread; CatalogueSort after

CatalogueSort.meaning: Sorts the item catalogue again, into its categories' starts (it only adds to them: they are zeroed first). On the game thread

params.name: mix_id
params.meaning: the item's mixId (one the catalogue lacks is ignored)

AddItemAmount.meaning: Adds to an owned item as the buy/v2 reply does: no popup, no backend request. On the game thread

params.name: mix_id
params.meaning: the item's mixId (one the catalogue lacks is ignored)

RemoveItemAmount.meaning: Takes an amount of an owned item away. On the game thread

LoadEntities.meaning: Loads the game's entity data (generated_entities.dl_bin) into the entity state: the entity map, short ids and component tables. HellForge's weapon and entity registry adds the mods' entities right after it returns

params.name: list
params.meaning: the armory list object it fills

BuildArmoryList.meaning: Builds the armory's list from the loadout entries (component 29) into a fixed 193-entry object: per-type starts at +0x1B24, counts at +0x1B40, 32-byte entries. HellForge's detour replaces it with a larger list of its own (hf_global_Armory points there)

params.name: id
params.meaning: the loadout id (a weapon's, as in its loadout entry)

ArmoryEntryOf.meaning: The armory entry of a loadout id, found by walking the armory's per-type ranges (hf_global_Armory): 32 bytes, the loadout id at +0 and the entity at +8 (u64); NULL when the armory lists none

params.name: id
params.meaning: the text id (a strings entry, or one HellForge added for a mod)

EngineText.meaning: game.dll's wrapper of the engine's text function (the slot at +1000 of hf_global_EngineApi's table): the text of an id, as a UTF-8 string. HellForge points that slot at its own, so mod texts answer here too; the armory calls the slot directly, so hook the slot, not this, to change texts

params.name: presenter
params.meaning: the menu presenter to open (6 the information terminal, 41 the debug lobby browser)

OpenMenuPresenter.meaning: Opens a menu presenter on this machine's ship UI. HellForge's terminal detour turns presenter 6 (the information terminal) into 41 (the lobby browser) or opens nothing when an editor shows its own browser

MenuSoundUpdate.meaning: The menu sound manager's update, once a frame on the game thread, in missions and on the ship. HellForge's detour runs package requests and hf->on_game_thread callbacks there, before the game's own update

RequestPackages.meaning: Takes a reference on packages so the engine loads and keeps them. Game thread only: it changes the system's reference map without a lock, and a full map writes to address 0. hf->load_package is the checked way to call it

params.name: out
params.meaning: where it writes the entity (the game's no-entity id when there is none)

EntityOfNetwork.meaning: The entity a network id names on this machine now, written to out (and out returned). hf->entity_of_network is the checked way to call it
EntityOfNetwork.source: HellForge's entity_of_network (channel.c; the pin in abilities.c)

params.name: out
params.meaning: the 0x4C-byte preview record it fills, returned

params.name: alternate
params.meaning: 1 for the fallback query (the game's missing-child fallback calls itself with 1)

QueryLoadoutPreview.meaning: The loadout unit-preview query: the record a loadout slot's preview shows; a missing loadout row gives a zero record. HellForge's detour breaks its fallback's endless self-call (G-8 Immolation in the hellpod)

PushArmoryLoadout.meaning: The armory's commit: pushes this machine's player's loadout from the profile to its PlayerHistory record (hf_global_PlayerHistory), the way a boot's validation applies a changed weapon. Game thread; its request is handled a few frames later

params.name: context
params.meaning: the level generation context: [[[+0x18] + 0x2D0] + 0x68] the generation settings, their cache loot tables at +0x90 (count +0x98, 0x28 bytes each: u32 id, i32 weight, i32 min and max difficulty, entries at +0x18, count +0x20)

RollCacheLoot.meaning: Level generation's QueueRandomCacheLootRewardsPackages pass: rolls each random loot cache against the generation settings' cache loot tables. HellForge's detour sets the Super Credits tables' weight to the plan's Forge Credits chance before the roll

params.name: currency
params.meaning: the mixId of the currency it is charged in (the warbond's; requisition 0xD7150EEC, Forge Credits 0x6C3C83C1)

RequestWarbondPurchase.meaning: Builds the buy request for a warbond item and records it as the progression's pending buy; its callers are the warbond page view and the MVVM popup. HellForge patches its entry so the currency is the item's own

params.name: progression
params.meaning: the progression manager: hf_global_Progression (its pending buy at +0x17799D8, the item at +0x17799DC)

FinishWarbondPurchase.meaning: Completes the reply to a warbond buy: charges the pending buy and appends its item, once, to the purchased list (count +0xD8A58, ids from +0xD8A5C). HellForge's detour takes a repeatable mod item out of the list again so it sells again

params.name: character
params.meaning: the showcase character's id (a row of the character table at game.dll+0x32B1E60)

SpawnWarbondShowcase.meaning: Spawns the Helldiver shown beside a warbond's card from its character row (kit, pose and weapon), on a card change. HellForge's detour fills a mod warbond's row once the catalogue and armory are ready

params.name: widget
params.meaning: the spent widget: its data block (a card's or the page view) at +0x2130, last frame's at +0x2138, its text element at +0x378

UpdateWarbondSpent.meaning: Updates the "#COUNT Medal(s) spent" widget on the Acquisition Center's cards and a warbond's page header. HellForge's detour gives it the text of the warbond's own currency

params.name: pager
params.meaning: the Acquisition Center's pager (its panel + 0x110): {count, current} read through [+0x7AE8], last frame's through [+0x7AF0]

UpdateWarbondPager.meaning: Lays out and lights the Acquisition Center pager's 32 dots for the card count and the current card. HellForge redirects its one call (0x194345A) to show pages of 32 past 32 warbonds

WarbondPagerInput.meaning: The pager's input: a clicked dot becomes the card to select (+0x7B14); nonzero when that changed. HellForge redirects its one call (0x1943384)

params.name: element
params.meaning: a UI text element of kind 0x1C0000 (kind: its +0 & 0x3C0000); its text id is at +0x110

SetElementText.meaning: Sets a UI text element's text id, which it then resolves through the engine's text function (mod texts included). The stratagem picker's headings and the warbond spent widget use it
SetElementText.source: HellForge's stratagem categories (stratagem_categories.c) and warbond texts (warbond_texts.c)

params.name: element
params.meaning: a UI text element of kind 0x200000 (kind: its +0 & 0x3C0000); its text id is at +0x110

SetElementTextAlt.meaning: SetElementText for text elements of kind 0x200000

params.name: name
params.meaning: the hash of the variable in its text (the picker heading's available count 0xEB646556, its total 0x4442EB89)

SetElementNumber.meaning: Fills a number variable in a UI text element's text

SetWidgetVisible.meaning: Shows or hides a UI widget. HellForge's locked-warbond button calls it on the button's price

params.name: rgb
params.meaning: its colour (3 floats: red, green, blue)

SetElementColour.meaning: Sets a UI element's colour. HellForge's warbond prices call it to tint a sample price in the sample's colour

params.name: widget
params.meaning: the heading widget: its title element at +0x110, its counts element at +0x3C8

params.name: key
params.meaning: the key of the section's first candidate

SetPickerHeading.meaning: Fills a stratagem picker section heading (its title and its available and total counts). HellForge redirects its call in the list's realize pass (0x18D2E85) to title mods' selection categories (hf->add_stratagem_category)

StratagemAvailable.meaning: Whether the player has a stratagem available to take, as the picker's heading counts it

params.name: compare
params.meaning: the comparator: int (const void*, const void*)

SortArray.meaning: Sorts an array with a comparator, qsort's arguments. The stratagem picker sorts its candidates with it (call 0x18D8C40), which HellForge redirects to group mods' categories

HighestDifficulty.meaning: Returns the highest difficulty level a player may choose: min(10, the online override "0xAF218CAC 0xFAABBEA9", which it finds with FindConfigSetting). Every read of the difficulty table clamps the level to it; once a mod's add_difficulty is installed its 10 is 11
HighestDifficulty.source: HellForge's level 11 (difficulty.c, DIF_MAX_FN and the live override)

params.name: online
params.meaning: HighestDifficulty passes 1: the online overrides (config +0x12078) are looked in before the defaults (+0xC050)

FindConfigSetting.meaning: Finds a config setting by key in the config's open-addressing tables of 48-byte entries. Returns the setting (+0xC its type, 6 a u32; +0x10 its value) or NULL
FindConfigSetting.source: HellForge's live level 11 (difficulty.c, DifficultyCapValue and kCapSitePin)

params.name: level
params.meaning: the widget's difficulty level (the bar passes its index + 1)

ShowDifficultyWidget.meaning: Shows the chosen widget of the war table's difficulty bar: its level's number, name and icon from the difficulty table, and its band sprite (a 10-entry array read by level - 1)

ComputeMissionRating.meaning: Rates the mission on the pause map and at mission end against a table of 10 rows of thresholds, indexed by the mission's level - 1

params.name: rcx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (its caller passes its rdi + 0x771F48)

EnemyDirectorTick.meaning: The enemy director's per-frame step: reads each faction's roaming patrol interval (difficulty row +0x2A0, f32 s) and most living patrol enemies (+0x2AC, u32) from the mission's difficulty row

params.name: arena
params.meaning: the arena (the level generator's generation arena: a pass's [rsi])

ArenaAllocate.meaning: Allocates from an arena; the level generator's passes take their scratch tables from the generation arena with it

params.name: value
params.meaning: the byte to fill with (HellForge passes 0)

params.name: level
params.meaning: the level (lg): its caller, the world's creation, passes the world's +0xAE288

CreateGenerationBlock.meaning: Makes the level generator's generation block G (the level's locations, their types, the minimap's arrays, the mission stamps, the objective list, places and clusters), once per world (from 0xAB8B70)

params.name: level
params.meaning: the level (lg): the world passes its +0xAE288

InitLevel.meaning: Level init: copies the generation settings' radii into the level (lg+0x2D78..+0x2D8C), sets the map type (lg+0x2DE0) and the view rect a war-table preview is drawn in (lg+0x2D94)

GenerateRouteCells.meaning: The level generator's route cells: a Poisson disc of sites at the generation settings' spacing (+4, 40 m) in the disk (+0xC, 680 m) around the world's centre, into fixed arrays (975 vertices, 1621 edges, 1024 cells) it does not check

params.name: rcx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi + 8)

params.name: rdx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi)

params.name: pass
params.meaning: the pass context: +8 = lg+0x2D20 (the level's radii), +0x18 the level (lg)

GenerateRouteCellVoronoi.meaning: Level generator pass op 3: fills each route cell with points at its cell type's size (+0x18C) / 2 (grid) or / 4 (Poisson) and builds their diagrams into the block's areas (13224) and vertices (26205), unchecked

params.name: rcx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi + 8)

params.name: unused
params.meaning: not read (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi)

params.name: pass
params.meaning: the pass context: +8 = lg+0x2D20 (the level's radii), +0x18 the level (lg)

GenerateSubregionHeights.meaning: Level generator pass op 4: gives every area of a route cell the height of its cell type's curve at t = clamp(d / 64 m), d its distance to the nearest route point

params.name: rcx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi + 8)

params.name: rdx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi)

params.name: pass
params.meaning: the pass context: +8 = lg+0x2D20 (the level's radii), +0x18 the level (lg)

GenerateVoronoi.meaning: Level generator pass op 0x25: lays a 16 m grid (generation settings +0) over the site square, keeps the points within the disk and runs jc_voronoi on them (arrays of 5680 sites, 5849 vertices, 11528 edges, unchecked)

params.name: rcx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi + 8)

params.name: rdx
params.meaning: not reviewed: pass it on (the pass dispatcher passes its rsi)

SelectObjectives.source: HellForge's two missions in one (difficulty_missions.c, g_select)

MissionTimerWidget.meaning: The mission's timer widget: the countdown's total less what is left (hf_global_HiveMindManager +0x51948) is the elapsed time and its segments

UpdateHudObjectives.meaning: The in-mission HUD's objective updater: copies every objective instance's id (hf_global_ObjectiveManager) into a 16-entry stack list to number them, and gives each map marker one of the map's 16 marker slots

HudMandatoryObjectives.meaning: The HUD's list of the mission's class 0 and 1 objectives (main objectives and steps), 16 at most

TelemetryMissionEnd.meaning: The mission-end telemetry: keeps up to 16 objective instances in hf_global_Telemetry's record (+0x31820)

ArtilleryAim.meaning: The SEAF Artillery's aim: reads the shell's speed and gravity from its projectile row, through SolveBallisticAim

SolveBallisticAim.meaning: The ballistic solver the artillery's aim uses, with the projectile row's speed and gravity

GenerateDefencePlanetMissions.meaning: Generates a defence planet's missions on the war table's mission board (slots 0..29, 3 per level)

DifficultyBarDestroy.meaning: Destroys the war table difficulty bar's widgets

params.name: r8

params.name: image

SetImageWithBase.meaning: Sets an image element from a base sprite and an image: the mission HUD's top bar sets the difficulty icon with it
